name: Pinturas Axalta - Pinturas y Acabados Gain
summary: Pinturas Axalta - Pinturas y Acabados Gain is a specialized automotive paint and coatings retailer representing the global Axalta brand in San Luis Río Colorado. The location serves body shops and automotive professionals with premium refinishing products and free professional training through the Axalta Academy.
demographics: The shopping center serves the border community of San Luis Río Colorado, attracting a diverse customer base of automotive professionals, body shop operators, and vehicle owners from both Mexico and the United States. The trade area includes middle-income households with a strong presence of skilled tradespeople and small business owners in the automotive repair industry. Visitors typically range from 25-55 years old with practical, value-conscious shopping patterns focused on professional-grade automotive products and services.
description: Pinturas Axalta - Pinturas y Acabados Gain is a specialized automotive paint and coatings retail location in San Luis Río Colorado, Sonora, representing the globally recognized Axalta brand with over 150 years of experience in the coatings industry. As a world leader in automotive refinishing solutions, this location serves body shops, multi-shop operators, and automotive dealerships throughout the border region with innovative, colorful, and sustainable coating systems designed to make vehicles look like new. The store offers comprehensive product lines including primers, transparent coatings, color bases, and fillers under premium brands like Cromax, Duxone, Spies Hecker, and Imlar. Operating from 8:00 AM to 6:30 PM, the facility provides not only products but also free professional training through the Axalta Academy, helping local automotive professionals elevate their skills and business operations. With a strong 4.5-star rating from 46 reviews, this location has established itself as a trusted resource for the automotive refinishing community in the San Luis Río Colorado area.
